# Research Figure

Create, revise, audit, or integrate one evidence-bearing figure from traceable sources. Every value, arrow, label, and caption claim must remain inside the supplied evidence.

## Prerequisites

- The operation, reader job, bounded claim, traceable evidence or data, target paper or slide surface, output format, and an available project generation route.

## Method

1. Lock the figure contract and its non-claims.
2. Prefer deterministic project plotting or LaTeX routes, then deterministic vector or structured-spec routes when data, topology, labels, or geometry can be expressed exactly.
3. Build plots and tables from actual data and retain reproducible generation source. Diagrams require editable source or a structured specification.
4. Preserve pairing or block IDs and report `n`, units, center and spread, and metric definitions when applicable.
5. Inspect the actual render at target scale for readability, clipping, labels, hierarchy, and source fidelity. Without a render, make no visual-QA claim.
6. Bound the caption to what is shown, what to notice, the supported takeaway, and scope limits.

## Profiles and output

This package is lightweight-only and has no managed capability. Return the figure asset or audit/blocker, editable or generation source, the actual-render inspection result when available, and a bounded caption. Keep failed renders and checks visible.

## Stop conditions

Stop after one figure asset or audit is delivered or blocked with source and claim boundaries, a reproducible route, actual-render inspection when applicable, and a bounded caption.

## Authority boundary

Do not invent data, use AI illustration or style transfer as evidence, launch a provider, model, child Skill, Worker, Workflow, capability, Procedure, or Dispatch, mutate canonical Research or Quest state, or invoke another stage automatically. Write only request-authorized output paths.

## Handoff

Suggest `research-experiment` for result-data ownership or `research-writing` for narrative integration only as separate explicit selections. Never invoke either automatically.
